continue_recommended_reason: The charter's stop_promote_rule terminates this team immediately after the named verdict plus exactly ONE bounded candidate cause. Both were delivered: verdict CLASSIFICATION_ONLY over 3 accepted bundles and all 4 frozen reality-check legs, with non-vacuity proven on all 3 real bundles and byte-identical reproducibility across 3 independent runs. No concrete defect in the harness remains open (the 4 defects found were fixed and locked by tests). named_verdict_answer: The counter-authority capability is classification-only, not retrieval-independent. Across 3 accepted bundles, 0 of 8 counter-authority rows entered through any retrieval channel the initial broad pass did not use; the accepted AdversarialPass holds no retrieval client and sees a deterministic 24-decision shortlist of the initial pool, leaving 89.4% / 91.6% / 76.0% of the retrieved corpus structurally uninspected.
single_bounded_candidate_cause: AdversarialPass.__init__ takes (bundle, answer) and holds no retrieval client; _prompt_decisions() selects only from that bundle, so the declared independence ('separate model call, challenge-only objective, bounded deterministic source shortlist') is model-call independence, not retrieval independence. Evidence: interface signature; the pass's own prompt_strategy/independence provenance strings; offline replay reproducing prompt_decisions=24 and b6_pool_never_seen_rate 0.894/0.916/0.760; b1_adversarial_channel_rows=0 and b2_new_channels=[] on all 3 bundles; provenance.retrieval_component='frontier-query-retrieval/v2' with stages=['search'] and no adversarial retrieval request attributed anywhere; and all 8 counter rows at ranks 1,3,5,6,13,14,27,3, i.e. where the ranked list already shows them. THIS TEAM DID NOT TEST THE FIX.
lane_discharge_followup: Per the charter's lane_discharge fallback, the single named candidate cause is handed to product as decision input.
